title: Compassionate Care Network: A Muslim Physician’s Initiative
note: Demo snapshot of public ifanca.org content, for a training session only. Not an official IFANCA dataset. Content may be out of date. Check ifanca.org for current information.

blocks.text: Forty-three million people are uninsured in America. Nearly 50 percent of the uninsured live in the suburbs and have an average annual income of $50,000 or less. These individuals/families do not usually qualify for any insurance programs offered by the government and may not have coverage as they are either self-employed and cannot afford the cost or are working in places where such benefits are not provided.

Chicagoland-based Compassionate Care Network (CCN) is intended for individuals who do not have insurance. CCN offers an individual membership for $30 or a $60 family membership for 6 months. This is renewable. There is also a $25 flat fee per office visit per patient. CCN also offers free health screenings at various locations.

For more details visit CCN online at www.ccnchicago.com, email info@ccnchicago.com; albanypark@sbcglobal.net or contact Quader & Associates; 5330 W. Devon Avenue, Suite 17, Chicago, IL 60646; Tel. (773) 775-3600; Fax (773) 583-1487.
